title: Aeroplane with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- wings -->
  <polygon points='50,52 14,66 14,72 50,60' fill='#4A90D9'/>
  <polygon points='50,52 86,66 86,72 50,60' fill='#4A90D9'/>
  <!-- wing highlights -->
  <polygon points='50,53 18,65 18,67 50,57' fill='#7FB4E8'/>
  <polygon points='50,53 82,65 82,67 50,57' fill='#7FB4E8'/>
  <!-- tail fin -->
  <polygon points='26,44 16,24 16,30 26,48' fill='#E8552D'/>
  <polygon points='26,44 20,28 20,32 26,46' fill='#FF8A66'/>
  <!-- horizontal tail -->
  <polygon points='26,46 12,48 12,52 26,50' fill='#E8552D'/>
  <polygon points='26,47 15,49 15,50 26,49' fill='#FF8A66'/>
  <!-- fuselage -->
  <ellipse cx='56' cy='52' rx='34' ry='11' fill='#F2F2F0'/>
  <path d='M22,52 Q22,41 56,41 L80,41 Q90,41 90,52 Q90,63 80,63 L56,63 Q22,63 22,52 Z' fill='#F2F2F0'/>
  <!-- belly shading -->
  <path d='M26,55 Q56,67 88,55 Q88,61 80,62 L56,62 Q30,62 26,55 Z' fill='#CFD3D6'/>
  <!-- nose cone -->
  <path d='M84,43 Q92,44 92,52 Q92,60 84,61 Q88,52 84,43 Z' fill='#E8552D'/>
  <!-- cockpit windows -->
  <rect x='62' y='45' width='7' height='5' rx='2' fill='#2B6CB0'/>
  <rect x='72' y='45' width='7' height='5' rx='2' fill='#2B6CB0'/>
  <!-- facial screen panel -->
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='52' rx='14' ry='8' fill='#1B1B2E'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='39' cy='50' r='2' fill='#5EEAD4'/>
  <circle cx='49' cy='50' r='2' fill='#5EEAD4'/>
  <!-- blush -->
  <circle cx='35' cy='54' r='1.6' fill='#FF7AA2'/>
  <circle cx='53' cy='54' r='1.6' fill='#FF7AA2'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M39,54 Q44,58 49,54' stroke='#5EEAD4' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- propeller hub + blades -->
  <circle cx='92' cy='52' r='2' fill='#E8552D'/>
</svg>
